# `prepare_utf16` with a poll, a live and a release callback that each pushed an
# event to a list, and one marker pushed by a one-line insertion just before the
# loop's successor code (the construction of the source snapshot, which stays in
# surgeist-css). The file was restored and its digest re-checked afterwards.
# The absolute levels the live and release callbacks received were turned into
# the changes below. The values are therefore the old function's, not this
# crate's output.

#   loop_steps       polls the old loop made, which is the work it charged
#   level_after_loop live level when the loop ended
#   changes          S = one step; A<n> = n bytes added; R<n> = n bytes released, in the order made
#                    after the first live level and up to the end of the loop
